alt: Thyroid hormone synthesis in a follicular cell. The basolateral Na/I symporter pumps iodide in from blood; pendrin moves it across the apical membrane into the colloid; thyroid peroxidase oxidises iodide and iodinates tyrosines on thyroglobulin, then couples them; iodinated thyroglobulin is endocytosed and cleaved by lysosomes to free thyroxine and triiodothyronine, which leave through MCT transporters into the blood.
